firstViewportText: Semaglutide Prescription medicine · Professional supervision is normally required. A regulator classifies this substance in a way that restricts how it is supplied. The US label carries a boxed warning. In 10 seconds Does it work? How it works Safety Interactions For someone like me? What to measure Alternatives Unknowns Deep evidence What changed · No reviewed conclusion yet In 10 seconds Prescription medicine · Last evidence check 2026-09-06 · No reviewed conclusion yet What it is Semaglutide is a prescription medicine. ✓ Verified evidence present § Regulatory label A register records an approval with a prescription-only classification.
